bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than DIN A4 are not allowed into the event areas. Security staff at the entrance make the final call on all items.
allowed: Baby and toddler food and drinks
Drinks up to 0.5 l in PET or Tetra Pak with a medical certificate
prohibited: Backpacks and bags larger than DIN A4
Photo, video and audio recording devices
Power banks larger than a typical smartphone
bagPolicy.note: Walking aids for people with limited mobility are exempt from the stick ban. Guide dogs are allowed.

parking.note: Parking at LANXESS Arena's P5 lot is available 24/7 with a fee of 1.00 € per 30 minutes. Payment can be made with cash or NFC-enabled cards. The lot is suitable for vehicles over 1.90 m, including buses and RVs.

rideshare.note: Find taxi ranks on Gummersbacher Straße below the southwest entrance and at the Bf Deutz/LANXESS arena transit station.

concessions.summary: The Backstage Restaurant, on the north side at box level, serves a buffet that is usually booked ahead together with a matching ticket category. You can also join the buffet on event day, and guests not eating there can still get a drink at its bar. There is no à la carte service.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by LANXESS Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in LANXESS Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at LANXESS Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at LANXESS Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
